name: Atelier Cologne
note: All unisex: every Atelier Cologne scent is unisex, so both tabs show the same list. The house is built on citrus 'Cologne Absolue' scents; Orange Sanguine is the famous one and the best rated. Most scores sit between 7 and 7.8, so the range is consistent rather than standout. Owned by L'Oréal since 2016.
